notes: Hi-res image source manifest from the hunt (Hyperagent + scouts Scout1/Scout2). Download LOCALLY into data/images/ (analysis input only; private repo; nothing republished). license: 'CC-*' = freely reusable with attribution (safe to publish our figure of it); '(c) ...' = copyrighted, fair-use analysis only. All verify_status RESOLVED entries returned HTTP 200 + image content-type from the sandbox on 2026-07-25 (sizes noted).
freely_licensed_publishable: chilbolton-2001-reconstruction (Wikimedia CC-BY-SA 3.0) — pixel-accurate DIAGRAM of the message panel, not a photo
corrections: Poirino 2011 ASCII decodes to 'Ea Enki' (Sumerian creator god), NOT 'Timeo ETI' (a common internet misattribution).
Poirino 2010 (separate, same field) encodes E=mc2 in decimal ASCII.
Wilton Windmill 2010 Euler string has a debated anomaly (an 'h'/Planck-constant-looking glyph) — worth checking in a careful bit read.

sources.title: Barbury Castle Pi
sources.license: CC-BY 3.0 (Panoramio upload 'sirk_nala', Lucy Pringle aerial) — verify tag on file page
sources.why_interesting: Pi to 10 sig figs (encoding.verify_barbury_pi). FREELY LICENSED aerial photo — publishable.

sources.title: Chilbolton Arecibo-reply message panel (reconstruction)
sources.why_interesting: Pixel-accurate 23x73 rendering of the Arecibo-reply message. IDEAL clean input for B2/chilbolton_grid + grid_analyze + encoding.verify_chilbolton_reply, and it's freely licensed.

sources.title: Chilbolton (both formations + radio telescope)
sources.why_interesting: Real aerial showing Face + Message beside the telescope; low-res though. Use the CC reconstruction for the actual bit grid.

sources.title: Wilton Windmill — Euler's identity
sources.why_interesting: 8-bit ASCII of Euler's identity e^(i*pi)+1=0 around a 12-segment ring (debated 'h' anomaly). Prime target: grid_analyze + an ASCII decoder. NEW candidate formation.

sources.title: Poirino 'Ea Enki' ASCII (heptagram)
sources.why_interesting: 7-point star; outer ring = 8-bit ASCII 'Ea Enki'. ASCII-decode + grid_analyze target. NEW candidate. NOTE: fetch with Referer https://www.margheritacampaniolo.it/

sources.title: Poirino E=mc^2 ASCII
sources.why_interesting: 6-petal formation encoding E=mc^2 in DECIMAL ASCII; first of the 2-year Poirino sequence. ASCII-decode target. NEW candidate.

sources.title: Crabwood alien face + ASCII disc (full)
sources.location: Crabwood Farm, nr Winchester, Hampshire, UK
sources.why_interesting: Best FREE full-formation aerial; TV-scanline halftone face + spiral ASCII disc ('Beware the bearers of FALSE gifts...'). Disc detail marginal at this scale (see B1/C1).

sources.title: Crabwood ASCII disc close-up (small, free)
sources.why_interesting: Best FREE disc-specific close-up, but only 400px — likely still too low for BER<0.4 (C1 = paid TT master remains the real unlock).

sources.location: Windmill Hill, nr Avebury, Wiltshire, UK
sources.why_interesting: Three interlocking Julia-like arms, 197 circles; self-similarity vs true-Julia test (encoding.is_true_julia_set).

sources.location: Milk Hill, nr Alton Barnes, Wiltshire, UK
sources.why_interesting: Koch-triangle geometry, 198 circles/144 edges. Fractal-dimension target. Higher-res (c) alt: Alamy 1300x960 (Heritage/RCHME, watermarked).
